T3 habits, trackers, time, goals, charts and checklists: score tables

Every variant scored by python tools/screens/toast_opt.py, from drawings measured in headless Edge (360×740 phone, 1100×660 Windows). Axes are rank sums within a part, lower is better; ★ marks the Pareto front; each part's control (italics, dashed rule) was built to lose, and the run fails if it reaches the front. Grey rows failed the gate (a target under 48 dp).

Reference distance joins the axes once the reference apps are captured (t3-refs.json).

How this page is kept (owner, 2026-10-17): the newest pass first. A part still open shows its front and its control; a picked part shows only its picks; a part replaced by a later pass, or discarded, is one line naming the commit that last scored it and the JSON file where every score stays. Nothing replaced is drawn.

T3b.6b One home per thing, settled against the item's page: Measuring's strip and row, Review's day, This week, Saved charts, the Hub's lists

1728 variants and the control · 1729 pass the gate · 8 on the front (★).

Axes, lower is better: Redundancy = rank-sum of redundancy; Customization = rank-sum of custom (more is better); Settings burden = rank-sum of burden; Taps = rank-sum of taps; Glance = rank-sum of glance (more is better); Mental load = rank-sum of load; Consistency = rank-sum of inconsistent; Harmony = rank-sum of asym, balance_h, balance_v, rhythm, edges; Hierarchy = rank-sum of rep_above, own_rows (more is better).

Control: the source apps merged as they come: every repeat kept, Chronicle's dashboard over Measuring and its Frequent list on the Hub, This week's charts and totals both. Control lost: off the front; 1019 of 1728 passing variants have a lower sum.
